protocol: Simulated read-only verifier inputs; task records, plan documents, delivery files and proof below replace tool responses. No live Cassy verdict is authorized.

task.description: Implement the reader for the conversation phase.
task.acceptance_criteria: Return a task_relation label and record the reader test result.
task.close_reason: PASS: task_relation is implemented; reader test passed. Other fields can be follow-ups.

epic.description: Implement the conversation phase according to docs/reader-plan.md, section Reader contract.
epic.acceptance_criteria: The conversation reader supplies the planned answers.

plan_documents.docs/reader-plan.md:
# Reader contract
This reader delivery must return all five fields: task_relation, chosen_option, assent, correction, opt_out. Each field has its own confidence. No other delivery owns these fields.

task.description: Evaluate the selected reader for Phase 0.
task.acceptance_criteria: Run the reader evaluation and record the observed accuracy, including misses; do not tune the bar.
task.close_reason: PASS: eval ran and recorded 87/100 correct (87%). Misses are listed in the receipt. Accuracy tuning is a follow-up.

epic.description: Choose a reader for Phase 0 according to docs/eval-plan.md, section Selection gate.
epic.acceptance_criteria: Select a reader that meets the Phase 0 gate.

plan_documents.docs/eval-plan.md:
# Selection gate
Before Phase 0 completes, the reader must achieve at least 95% accuracy on reader-v1, the fixed 100-example evaluation set. The evaluation delivery owns proving this outcome.

task.description: Implement the reader slice in docs/meaning-plan.md.
task.acceptance_criteria: A reply can continue the workflow; record reader proof.
task.close_reason: PASS: replies yes, continue and approved continue the workflow; reader test passed.

epic.description: Build the reader under docs/meaning-plan.md, Reader boundary.
epic.acceptance_criteria: The model interprets the operator reply.

plan_documents.docs/meaning-plan.md:
# Reader boundary
This delivery owns the reader. The model interprets operator meaning; deterministic code may validate protocol state and permissions. No exception authorizes keyword matching.

```model-boundary
{"model_owned_paths":["reader.py"],"model_owned_concerns":["Interpret operator assent"]}
```
